chunks: A man asked al-Sadiq عليه السلام and said:
Inform me about Laylat al-Qadr: was it, or does it occur in every year?
So he said: "If Laylat al-Qadr were removed, the Qur'an would be removed."

key_terms.الْقُرْآنُ: the Qur'an, the divine revelation whose abiding presence is invoked here
key_terms.كُلِّ عَامٍ: every year; indicating recurring annual occurrence
key_terms.لَيْلَةِ الْقَدْرِ: Laylat al-Qadr, the Night of Decree of unique divine significance

ai.seo_question: Does Laylat al-Qadr occur every year according to Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith affirms that Laylat al-Qadr is not limited to the past but remains present continuously. The Imam عليه السلام links its استمرار to the abiding presence of the Qur'an, indicating its enduring reality and significance in every year.
